WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(f.rebtotal) as overall_avg_rebate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    o.ordertune,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebate,
    AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) as avg_rate_diff
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
)
SELECT 
  g.orderslink,
  g.ordertune,
  g.avg_rebate,
  g.avg_rate_diff,
  g.avg_rebate - oa.overall_avg_rebate as rebate_diff
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE g.avg_rebate > oa.overall_avg_rebate
ORDER BY rebate_diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
